name: GitHub Tools
description: Agent tools for public GitHub repositories: reviews waiting, CI status and prefilled issues.

prs_needing_review.description: List open pull requests in public repositories that wait for this GitHub user's review, and the user's own open pull requests still waiting for a review.

ci_status.description: Tell whether the latest commit on a public repository's branch (its default branch unless named) passes CI, with failing and running checks.

draft_issue.description: Make a github.com link that opens a new issue in a public repository with the title, body and labels filled in. The person presses Create on GitHub; nothing is filed by the tool.
